_comment: Pins tools/extract_projections.py to the owner's Hazelton_2026_Team_Projections.xlsx layout. Projections come from the four Rankings sheets (columns A-B: Player, Points, one row per player; column G: Position). Team comes from the 32 team sheets, whose tables carry Player and Positional Rank. The workbook has no games column, so ppg is season points divided by season_games.

owner_rankings._comment: The owner's own weekly rankings, one overall superflex PPR list with RK, PLAYER NAME, TEAM, POS (position plus rank within it) and OPP. Read with tools/owner_rankings.py extract, blended with the projections by tools/owner_rankings.py blend at this weight (owner share of the blended value). Series that load the model order by the blended value when a file for the week exists.
